intuition.title: Study context: Synthesis versus measurement
intuition.text: The gel preparation/decomposition gives the source nanocrystalline ZnO. Empty-cell cleaning, high-vacuum conditioning and hot vaporization belong to analysis; they do not supply additional growth schedules.

intuition.title: Study context: Aging interpretation
intuition.text: The authors interpret nanocr1 as metastable and nanocr2 as aged material with vaporization behavior closer to microcrystalline ZnO. No new particle size or storage atmosphere is reported.

intuition.title: Study context: Formal ion ratios
intuition.text: The Zn+/O2+ signals cannot determine vapor molar composition because scattered oxygen gives uncontrolled background. The table ratio remains an instrumental observation.

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
